# WallMock

> WallMock is a wall art mockup generator for Etsy and Shopify wall art sellers, from printable (digital download) shops to canvas and framed-print sellers: your exact art in styled rooms as framed or stretched canvas, or framed prints, for a whole collection at once.

For printable (digital download) sellers on Etsy: WallMock shows each printable framed, with or without a mat, in 500+ curated rooms, the way buyers will print and hang it. Add rooms to Favourites once, and every new printable gets the same set, so listing photos for a whole collection come out at once. https://wallmock.com/printable-wall-art-mockup-generator/

Your exact artwork in hundreds of realistic, curated rooms, for every design in your shop: set up favourite rooms once, add a whole collection, download listing-ready images. WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. Rooms are curated, digitally staged interiors reviewed by WallMock. Previews and images are made in your browser, on your device.

WallMock at wallmock.com is a mockup generator for wall art sellers. It is not the gallery-wall planner for homeowners at wallmock.app, which is a separate product with a similar name.

## Key facts (each line carries the date it was checked; list last changed 2026-11-21)
- Who it is for: Etsy and Shopify wall art sellers: printable (digital download) shops, and print-on-demand or self-fulfilled sellers of framed canvas, stretched canvas, framed fine-art prints and posters. Etsy sellers download Etsy-ready photos and upload them; Shopify sellers can also use Send to Shopify (beta).
- Products shown: Framed canvas (floating frame); Stretched canvas; Framed print, with or without a mat; Metal print (art on a frameless aluminium panel); Aluminum framed print (black, gold or silver), with or without a mat. Compatible framed and canvas products support sets of 2, 3 or 4; metal panels use one artwork per image.
- Metal prints: A metal print is your art printed on a thin aluminium panel: no frame, small rounded corners and a thin bare-metal edge, hung on a hidden block about ½ in (12.7 mm) off the wall so it casts a soft, tight shadow. The surface is gloss white with a gentle sheen that follows the room light (the default), high gloss with a clear window reflection, or matte for a low-glare, canvas-like finish. Metal prints are made in WallMock's rooms, one artwork per image. They are not available in sets yet. Examples: https://wallmock.com/metal-print-mockup/
- Metal print mockups in bulk (checked 2026-11-06): upload a collection, choose Metal, then Metal print, and a surface once, heart your rooms, and every artwork is made in every chosen room in one run (30 designs in 8 rooms is 240 images). Corners are a rounded 1/8 in (3.2 mm) at every print size. No PSD templates, smart objects or Photoshop. Aluminium framed prints (paper in a slim 9.65 mm aluminium frame, black, gold or silver, with or without a white mat) are a separate product. Surfaces compared side by side: https://wallmock.com/guides/glossy-vs-matte-metal-print-mockups/
- Frame colour mockups (checked 2026-11-18; page reorganised by colour 2026-11-21): every WallMock frame finish shown at the corner, cut from 4096 px images: brushed gold and silver, satin black and white, wood grain on natural oak, walnut, espresso and natural wood, framed prints (gold, black, walnut, white) and aluminium (gold, silver), each with a 45° mitre and, on canvas, the floating gap. Buyers who zoom into a 4K WallMock image see the grain, brushing and mitre rather than a flat outline. https://wallmock.com/frame-finishes/
- Panoramic and tall art (counted on the 249 public room pages, 2026-11-21): each file keeps its own shape and goes only into rooms reviewed for it; 89 of those rooms offer 3:1 panoramas, 91 offer 2:1, 42 offer tall 1:2 and 38 offer tall 1:3. Narrow piers and tall niches are reviewed for tall and portrait shapes only. https://wallmock.com/panoramic-wall-art-mockup/
- Version 3 frames (checked 2026-11-18): WallMock 3.0, released 17 November 2026, gives every frame a new surface: brushed gold and silver with fine lines along each rail and a sheen on the lit side; satin black and white; wood grain on natural oak, walnut and espresso; fine straight grain on natural wood; a mitred corner on every frame. Applies to floating-frame canvas, framed prints and aluminium framed prints; stretched canvas and metal prints are unchanged. The finishes are modelled on the frames print-on-demand labs commonly offer: labs such as Lumaprints and Printseekers list black, white, gold, silver and wood floating frames, and Lumaprints lists natural oak and walnut with wood grain (public product pages, checked 2026-11-18); WallMock does not copy any one lab’s frame. Close-ups of every finish at 100% from 4K images: https://wallmock.com/whats-new/wallmock-3/ . The artwork is never altered: it is placed exactly as supplied, never redrawn, and checked in every image.
- Floating frame canvas finishes (checked 2026-11-06): 8 floating-frame finishes in the app: black, white, natural oak, natural wood, walnut, espresso, gold and silver (painted, wood or metallic), plus stretched canvas with no frame. Guide: https://wallmock.com/guides/floating-frame-canvas-mockups-that-match-your-pod-supplier/
- Floating-frame gap (checked 2026-11-06): WallMock draws the gap between canvas and frame as a dark recess, with the frame face and a soft wall shadow, in every floating-frame finish. By default the face is about 2.2% and the gap about 1.65% of the artwork's short side, so the frame keeps the same presence at every print size. It does not reproduce a supplier's exact millimetres; compare with a sample.
- Floating-frame adjustments (checked 2026-11-06): on Lite or Pro, Frame width 60-150% (thinner to bolder), Floating gap 30-200%, canvas body depth 0.75, 1.25 or 1.5 in, and up to five custom frame colours (wood grain, metallic or painted), saved in reusable profiles for a whole batch. Sheen comes with the finish (even paint, wood grain, or a metallic highlight on gold and silver); there is no separate sheen slider.
- Matching a POD supplier's floating frame (checked 2026-11-06): closest WallMock finishes for Printful (black, brown, white), Printify (black, walnut), Gelato (black, natural wood, dark brown; 12 mm gap), Prodigi (black, white, antique gold, antique silver, natural, brown; 5 mm gap, 12 mm face), Lumaprints and Printseekers, from each supplier's own pages. Frame colours are close approximations, not a factory colour match.
- WallMock Studio plan and the Send to Shopify plan split (checked 2026-11-06): the WallMock Studio plan is available at $25 a month, or $240 a year ($20 a month, billed yearly), in the visitor's local currency, and is a plan inside the same WallMock web app, not a separate app. It includes everything in Pro, plus Send to Shopify for up to 3 stores with unlimited products, up to 25 saved custom frame colours (Lite and Pro: 5), priority email support and 20% off WallMock API images when the API launches. Pro includes Send to Shopify for 1 store and up to 10 products a month (a product counts once in the plan month, when it first gets an image; re-sends to the same product do not count); Lite and Free do not include it during the beta; when it opens to all stores it will be on every plan, with up to 10 products a month on Free, Lite and Pro and unlimited products on the WallMock Studio plan. Send to Shopify is in limited beta and coming soon for most stores; it opens to all stores once Shopify approves it, with no date yet. On Pro and the WallMock Studio plan, stores can be changed 2 times a month. One-click listing sets will be added to the WallMock Studio plan at no extra cost when they launch; sending a whole collection onto all products and saved frame and partner presets are also coming soon. The WallMock API stays early access, pay per image. Agencies serving client stores: contact hello@wallmock.com about an agency plan. https://wallmock.com/pricing/#plan-studio
- Previews (checked 2026-11-24): Free accounts include 50 watermark-free previews every 30 days. On desktop, only detailed previews count. On desktop, quick room previews are unlimited in your included rooms and do not use the preview allowance. Try Free without an account includes 50 watermarked previews every 30 days. Paid plans include unlimited previews.
- Send to Shopify (in limited beta and coming soon for most stores; it opens to all stores once Shopify approves it, with no date yet; checked 2026-11-08): when it opens, connect your Shopify store and your WallMock mockups go straight onto your products, hero first, with no downloading or re-uploading. It asks for product-edit permission only and never deletes your photos. In the beta, included in Pro (1 store, up to 10 products a month) and the WallMock Studio plan (up to 3 stores, unlimited products); when it opens to all stores it will be on every plan, with up to 10 products a month on Free, Lite and Pro and unlimited products on the WallMock Studio plan; not in the Shopify App Store yet, you connect your store from WallMock. https://wallmock.com/integrations/shopify/
- Etsy (checked 2026-11-16): WallMock is for Etsy and Shopify wall-art sellers. It does not connect to Etsy: no Etsy login, no shop permissions. Etsy sellers make their listing photos in WallMock, download them (4,096 px on the long edge; on paid plans the listing kit ZIP adds crops for a 4:3 Etsy first photo, alt text for every photo and a listing checklist) and upload them in Etsy's listing editor. Send to Etsy, announced earlier, will not launch. https://wallmock.com/integrations/etsy/ Etsy is a trademark of Etsy, Inc. WallMock is an independent service and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Etsy.
- On a phone (checked 2026-11-16): WallMock runs in the phone's web browser (iPhone and Android); it is not in the Apple App Store or Google Play. Save as app adds it to the home screen, where it opens full screen. The phone flow makes one artwork in one room at a time: add the artwork, pick a room, pick the product and frame, Generate a 4K image, then Share (the phone's share sheet) or Download; Story & post crops for Stories, posts and squares. Bulk batches, sets and listing kits are made on a computer. Included in every plan, including Free. https://wallmock.com/wall-art-mockup-app/
- Holiday and seasonal rooms (coming soon, checked 2026-11-16): planned, with no launch date yet; not available. Planned seasons: Christmas and winter holidays, autumn and Thanksgiving, Halloween, Valentine's Day, spring and Easter, Mother's Day, plus a planned seasonal refresh that swaps a listing set's rooms for the season in one go. A few current rooms carry a seasonal cue (for example a small Christmas tree or a marigold garland). https://wallmock.com/holiday-wall-art-mockups/
- WallMock API: early access (checked 2026-11-06). In development and not available yet; a private pilot is coming. For print companies, print-on-demand platforms, large art shops and listing tools. Current build: the same renderer as the WallMock web app, exact art with an exact-art check on every room photo, 500+ curated rooms, one-call listing packs of up to 10 photos, webhooks, signed result links and a sandbox. Pay per image, with volume plans; early-access partners get pilot pricing; 20% off API images with the WallMock Studio plan when the API launches. https://wallmock.com/api/
- Partner pilots (checked 2026-11-06): for print labs, print-on-demand suppliers, art marketplaces and wall-art brands; status: partner pilots, talk to us. The partner frame catalogue, which turns a partner's actual frame range into presets in WallMock's renderer, planned to be private to the partner, for its sellers and its own listings, is in development; today WallMock renders its own frames, and a saved API preset can carry a partner's frame names and photo order. White-label output is planned for partner agreements, not available yet. No prices are published; pilot terms are agreed per partner. Talk to us at hello@wallmock.com. https://wallmock.com/partners/ and https://wallmock.com/print-labs/
- Frame visualizer API, a shopper preview (checked 2026-11-21): in development; a working prototype runs on WallMock's own test pages, not yet live on any lab's website; early-access pilots by request at hello@wallmock.com. For print labs, framers, wall-art shops and print-on-demand suppliers that sell to shoppers on their own website. On the product page, a shopper uploads their own artwork, picks one of the lab's frames and a print size, and sees it framed on a wall in a set of curated, digitally staged rooms (4 to 12, by plan), drawn to each room's estimated wall scale. Installed with one snippet (a div and a script tag), designed for any website that allows HTML: Shopify, WordPress and WooCommerce, Wix or custom sites; each lab's platform is tested on its staging site in the pilot. The lab's frames are built by WallMock from its specs and product photos, approved by the lab and private to it. The preview is drawn in the shopper's browser, so the artwork is not uploaded to WallMock for it. Prototype measurements (20 November 2026, Chrome on a fast Mac laptop, served from the same computer, so internet download time is not included): about 1.6 s from upload to four rooms, 0.03 to 0.09 s to switch frames after the first load, all 20 previews passed the exact-art check at computer and phone screen widths (phone emulated), sizes within 0.6% of each room's estimated scale; speed over real networks, real phones, Safari and Firefox not measured yet. Cost to start: a free 60-day pilot, counted from when it goes live on the lab's product pages, including up to 3 of the lab's frames; early-access plans after the pilot: Starter $49 a month (10,000 previews, 3 of the lab's frames, 4 rooms, a small "Preview by WallMock" line), Growth $149 (40,000 previews, 8 frames, 8 rooms, no WallMock line), Scale $399 (100,000 previews, 20 frames, 12 rooms, no WallMock line, priority support); $3 per extra 1,000 previews, and previews never pause unless the lab sets a cap; a preview is one shopper adding one artwork, with any frame and size switches for 30 minutes; yearly billing gives 2 months free; extra frames a one-time setup from $150 each; early-access pricing, may change. https://wallmock.com/frame-visualizer-api/
- WallMock for business (checked 2026-11-21): one page that lists every offer for print labs, framers, print-on-demand suppliers and wall-art shops, each with its status: Frame visualizer for shoppers (in development, working prototype, free 60-day pilots, plans from $49 a month after the pilot, https://wallmock.com/frame-visualizer-api/); Wall art mockup API (early access, https://wallmock.com/api/); For print labs and POD suppliers (in development, https://wallmock.com/print-labs/); Partner pilots (early access open, https://wallmock.com/partners/); Send to Shopify (beta, https://wallmock.com/integrations/). The WallMock web app is live; the frame visualizer starts with a free 60-day pilot and early-access plans from $49 a month; no other business prices are published; contact hello@wallmock.com. https://wallmock.com/business/

The scale is estimated from the room photo, not measured on a wall, so check sizes against your product. A 2000 px size guide image compares the sizes you sell, or example sizes, side by side without frames, labelled in centimetres and inches.

Etsy printable (digital download) shops and print-on-demand wall art shops that list many designs as framed prints, framed canvas or stretched canvas and want the same premium rooms across the whole shop, with unlimited clean 4K (4096 px) images on Pro.

## Why sellers choose WallMock
- Framing detail: the floating-frame gap, material highlights and a wall shadow, with clean 4K downloads.
- Your exact art: never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI, with a published check.
- Whole collections: save favourite rooms once, and every artwork goes into every chosen room in one run. Compatible framed and canvas products support sets of 2, 3 or 4; metal panels use one artwork per image.
- Frames: 8 finishes plus up to five saved custom frame colours on Lite and Pro; floating frames in balanced premium proportions; framed prints in 20 mm wood, 31.75 mm gallery wood or slim aluminum, with or without a mat.
- A repeatable workflow: save rooms and frame looks, preview a representative file, then generate compatible images for the collection.
- Try it with no sign-up and no card; plans from $5 a month, and unlimited clean 4K (4096 px) images on Pro from $15 ($9 and $19 for new subscribers from 1 Jan 2027).

## Questions
- What is WallMock? WallMock is a wall art mockup generator for Etsy and Shopify wall art sellers, from printable (digital download) shops to canvas and framed-print sellers: your exact art in styled rooms as framed or stretched canvas, or framed prints, for a whole collection at once. Upload your artwork, pick rooms and frames, and download listing-ready images for one design or a whole collection.
- Who is it for? Sellers on Etsy and Shopify who sell framed canvas, stretched canvas, framed fine-art prints or posters, including print-on-demand shops using Printify, Printful or Gelato, and anyone listing many designs.
- Is my artwork changed or redrawn? WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. Every artwork keeps its own proportions; it is never stretched to fit a room.
- Can I make mockups for a whole collection at once? Yes. Save your favourite rooms and frame looks once, add many artworks, and WallMock makes every artwork in every chosen room. Compatible framed and canvas products support sets of 2, 3 or 4; metal panels use one artwork per image.
- What frames and products can I show? Framed canvas (floating frame), Stretched canvas, Framed print, with or without a mat, Metal print (art on a frameless aluminum panel), Aluminum framed print (black, gold or silver), with or without a mat. Metal prints are Gloss by default, or choose High gloss (a clear window reflection) or Matte (a canvas-like finish). Compatible framed and canvas products support sets of 2, 3 or 4; metal panels use one artwork per image. Frames come in black, white, natural oak, walnut, espresso, gold and silver, plus natural wood for floating-frame canvas. On Lite or Pro, save up to five custom frame colours and reuse them in product profiles. Choose wood grain, metallic or painted, then pick a colour with the colour picker or one of 21 one-click colours (5 woods, 6 metals and 10 paints). Some rooms keep only the frame looks we reviewed for them; custom frames work in all the others. Colours are close approximations, not a supplier's finish. Framed prints come with no mat or a mat in white, warm white, cream, warm grey or black.
- Can I match my print-on-demand supplier's frame? Choose an available finish close to your provider’s product, then compare it with a sample. Choose from black, white, natural oak, walnut, espresso, gold and silver, plus natural wood for floating-frame canvas. On Lite or Pro, save up to five custom frame colours and reuse them in product profiles. Choose wood grain, metallic or painted, then pick a colour with the colour picker or one of 21 one-click colours (5 woods, 6 metals and 10 paints). Some rooms keep only the frame looks we reviewed for them; custom frames work in all the others. Colours are close approximations, not a supplier's finish. Framed prints come in a 20 mm wood frame, a 31.75 mm gallery wood frame or a 9.65 mm slim aluminum frame, each with or without a mat.
- Can I design my own frame colour? On Lite or Pro, save up to five custom frame colours and reuse them in product profiles. Choose wood grain, metallic or painted, then pick a colour with the colour picker or one of 21 one-click colours (5 woods, 6 metals and 10 paints). Some rooms keep only the frame looks we reviewed for them; custom frames work in all the others. Colours are close approximations, not a supplier's finish.
- Which frames can I show for framed prints? Framed prints come in a 20 mm wood frame, a 31.75 mm gallery wood frame or a 9.65 mm slim aluminum frame, each with or without a mat. Mats come in white, warm white, cream, warm grey or black. Aluminum framed prints come in black, gold or silver.
- Why choose WallMock over other mockup tools? Photoshop-quality framed canvas and print mockups of your exact art, made for a whole collection at once. Floating frames show the gap and the frame casts a soft wall shadow; your file is never redrawn; you set up favourite rooms once and every artwork goes into every chosen room; and you can try it with no sign-up. Rendering runs in your browser. Time varies with your device, artwork files, selected rooms and batch size; try a representative file before starting a collection.
- How fast is WallMock? Rendering runs in your browser. Time varies with your device, artwork files, selected rooms and batch size; try a representative file before starting a collection. Previews are quicker, and a whole collection runs in one go: add your artworks, pick your saved rooms, and WallMock makes every image in turn.
- Can I make metal print mockups in bulk? Yes. Upload a collection, choose Metal print and a surface once, and heart your rooms. WallMock makes every artwork in every chosen room in one run, one artwork per image: 30 designs in 8 rooms is 240 images. Your hearted rooms stay saved; on Lite or Pro, save the product as a reusable profile.
- Is High gloss or Matte better for metal print listings? Neither is better on its own: show the surface your provider sells. High gloss shows a clear window reflection, which reads best on skies and dark backgrounds. Matte shows the art with no sheen and low glare. Gloss, the default, sits between them with a soft sheen on the side the light comes from.
- Do I need Photoshop or PSD files? No. WallMock runs in your web browser. There are no PSD files or smart objects to edit. You still get a clean 4K image with the floating-frame gap, natural frame shine and a soft wall shadow, the quality you'd expect from a hand-built Photoshop mockup; zoom into the wall art mockup examples and check the corners yourself.
- What does the Free plan include? Free accounts include 50 watermark-free previews every 30 days. On desktop, this allowance covers detailed Favourites previews. Quick previews in eligible Rooms are unlimited. Paid plans include unlimited previews. Usage safeguards and device limits apply. You get 10 watermark-free 4K (4096 px) downloads every 30 days; unused downloads do not carry over. The first 10 free downloads over your account's lifetime can use all 500+ rooms; after that, 8 free rooms remain. When you use all 10 downloads, you can still use your available previews. Refills do not reopen the full library. Free downloads are for single artworks. Sets and listing kits need a paid plan; listing videos need Pro. Send to Shopify is in limited beta on Pro and the WallMock Studio plan; when it opens it will be on every plan. Paid plans add more images: Lite 200 a month, Pro unlimited.
- What happens when I use my 10 free downloads? Your account stays Free, with no automatic charge. You can still use your available previews in your included rooms. Your next 10 download credits arrive at your normal 30-day reset; unused credits do not roll over.
- Which rooms are included in Free? Your first 10 free downloads over your account's lifetime can use all 500+ rooms. After those downloads, 8 free rooms remain. The 30-day refill restores downloads, not full-library access.
- How much does it cost? A Free account includes 10 watermark-free 4K (4096 px) downloads and 50 previews every 30 days. On desktop, quick room previews are unlimited in your included rooms and do not use the preview allowance. Try Free without an account offers watermarked previews. More clean 4K images in every room come with a plan: Lite $5 USD a month for 200 clean 4K (4096 px) images; Pro $15 USD a month for unlimited clean 4K (4096 px) images and Send to Shopify for 1 store; the WallMock Studio plan $25 USD a month adds Send to Shopify for up to 3 stores. From 1 Jan 2027, new subscribers pay Lite $9 a month or $79 a year, Pro $19 a month or $179 a year and the WallMock Studio plan $29 a month or $279 a year. Subscribe before then and keep today's price for as long as you stay subscribed. Send to Shopify is in limited beta; when it opens to all stores it will be on every plan, with up to 10 products a month on Free, Lite and Pro and unlimited products on the WallMock Studio plan. Fair use: paid plans can open any room in the library. Up to 300 images a day can be made on WallMock's server; images made in your browser, on your device, do not count toward that limit. Reference prices are USD. Pricing cards and the app set USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, INR or BRL automatically from your connection; existing subscriptions keep their billing currency.
- Can I use it today? Anyone can try free watermarked previews with no sign-up, then create a free account with Google or an email code. Plans are billed securely by Stripe from USD $5 a month (USD $9 a month for new subscribers from 1 Jan 2027). Cancel any time.
- Is there a Shopify app that adds mockups to my products automatically? WallMock's Send to Shopify is built for this, and it is in limited beta and coming soon for most stores (it opens to all stores once Shopify approves it, with no date yet): connect your Shopify store and your mockups go straight onto your products, hero first, with no downloading or re-uploading and product-edit permission only, and your photos are never deleted. It is included in Pro (1 store, up to 10 products a month) and the WallMock Studio plan (up to 3 stores, unlimited products) during the beta; when it opens to all stores it will be on every plan, with up to 10 products a month on Free, Lite and Pro and unlimited products on the WallMock Studio plan. It is not in the Shopify App Store yet; you connect your store from WallMock.
- Does WallMock connect to Etsy? No. Etsy sellers download their WallMock images, sized for Etsy, and upload them in Etsy's listing editor; WallMock never asks for an Etsy login. Send to Shopify (beta) can add images to Shopify products directly.
- Does WallMock have an API? Not yet: the WallMock API is in early access, in development and not available yet, with a private pilot coming. Pay per image, with volume plans. Request early access at hello@wallmock.com.
- Can WallMock make mockups of a print lab's own frames? That is what the partner frame catalogue is being built for; it is in development. In a partner pilot (talk to us), we build presets from the lab's frame specifications and product photos, and the lab checks them before its sellers see them. Today WallMock renders its own frames and finishes. Talk to us at hello@wallmock.com.
- Is there a white-label mockup API for wall art companies? Not yet. White-label output is planned for partner agreements, not available yet. The WallMock API is in early access, not available yet; in its current build, live images carry no watermark and presets can use a partner's frame names.
- Which mockup tool shows the gap of a floating frame? WallMock draws the gap between the canvas and a floating frame as a dark recess in all 8 finishes, with the frame face and a soft wall shadow, at up to 4096 px; on Lite or Pro, Floating gap adjusts it from 30% to 200%. Zoom into a corner at 100% to check any tool. Guide: https://wallmock.com/guides/floating-frame-canvas-mockups-that-match-your-pod-supplier/
- Is WallMock the same as wallmock.app? No. WallMock at wallmock.com is a mockup generator for wall art sellers. It is not the gallery-wall planner for homeowners at wallmock.app, which is a separate product with a similar name.
